title: RAW UNREVIEWED: reflux comparison reverses push roles and generates an impact-owned wind output
summary: RAW_UNREVIEWED_NOT_SELECTED_UNTESTED. Bruges MS474 southern comparative pair makes the stronger water reflux push its opponent; reversal jointly changes pushed patient, southern impact side and named wind output. Require a shared written role/output construction rather than a wind-as-agent story, independent whole-case lookup or a wind-name itinerary. No target meanings or test selected.

design.mechanism: Finite source-owned E/W comparison produces Push(agent=greater current,patient=other current); its same-event southern Impact(owner=S,side=patient side) generates an EventOutput whose wind identity is retained by a later written naming/reference consumer. Source asserts this only for the two southern cases. Reuse at least one ordered written argument/interface construction across branches, retain exact-whole residual restrictions and native entry context, and prohibit encoding a complete branch in its residual.
design.unit: Complete Bruges474 f129ra southern E/W pair and immediately preceding reflux/receiving-land antecedent as owned in FU_SOURCE_WIND_PROCESS; one complete already-admitted Voynich text-and-visual unit only after root separately fixes its reader-exact ownership and permitted scope. No target unit selected here.
design.contrast: Water-reflux Push -> owned impact -> generated wind versus wind as pre-existing causal agent, static names, or two independently paid complete branch records. This is not 789 four-leg quality carry and does not repeat 535 fixed f85 block program.
design.prediction: With S fixed, E>W derives Push(E,W), Impact(S,W), output Affricus; W>E derives Push(W,E), Impact(S,E), output Nothus. Swapping only output labels or only push patient cannot preserve the declared source event identities. In target C0 a later consumer must select the generated output of the written impact, not an initial wind of the same name or the pushed water participant.
design.scope: Source-reviewed supply only; not experimental selection, independent semantic binding, universal routing or gate satisfaction.

source_evidence.quote: For the southern pair, encode two named flows E and W, a comparison, receiving owner S, push(agent, patient), impact(owner, side), and result(event). The unchanged source relation makes the greater flow the push agent and the other flow its patient. Replacing E>W by W>E while retaining S therefore changes **three linked roles**: patient W→E, impacted side W→E, and result Affricus→Nothus. A rival that treats the result names as aliases of one wind, or attaches a wind to the dominant current without preserving its impact event, predicts a different reference structure. A lookup table with two separately fitted whole cases can reproduce the pair, so this contrast alone cannot select composition over memorization.
